answer: Proof of Stake achieves Sybil resistance by tying identity to capital allocation rather than node count. An agent reaches the zenith of network influence by bonding native tokens, ensuring that creating a dune of fake identities remains economically irrational. Since validators must lock collateral to broadcast a signal, the cost of an attack equals the total value required to acquire a majority stake, rendering Sybil exploits prohibitively expensive and inherently self-defeating for the attacker.
